info.description: P2P Docker Compose orchestration with Cloudflare WARP mesh networking
info.title: Jetty API

post.description: Generates (or accepts) a new admin key, persists it on this node, and broadcasts it via memberlist so every peer adopts it. Returns the new key in the response. Admin only.

parameters.description: Rotation parameters (new_key optional - server generates if absent)
parameters.name: request

get.description: Returns a tar.gz of state.json + compose dir + warp dir. If X-Backup-Passphrase header is set, the tar.gz is wrapped with Argon2id+AES-GCM into the JETTY-ENC-V1 format - safe to share/store. Without the header, output is plain tar.gz (full credentials in the clear).
get.summary: Download a backup of cluster state

parameters.description: Optional passphrase. If present, the response body is JETTY-ENC-V1 wrapped instead of plain tar.gz.
parameters.name: X-Backup-Passphrase

200.description: tar.gz archive (or JETTY-ENC-V1 blob if passphrase set)

get.description: Returns the cluster's current backup schedule (or null if disabled). Admin only.

post.description: Admin-only. Body fields: interval_minutes (>=5), retention (0=unlimited), passphrase (optional, JETTY-ENC-V1 wraps every backup if set).
post.summary: Create or update the scheduled-backup config

delete.description: Removes the cluster's scheduled-backup config. Existing backup files on disk are not deleted. Admin only.

get.description: Returns all stored environment variable keys (values are encrypted)

post.description: Stores encrypted environment variables (existing keys are overwritten)

get.description: Returns the decrypted value of a specific environment variable

delete.description: Removes an environment variable from storage

get.description: Returns health status of this node or the entire cluster. Use node=local for just this node.

parameters.description: Filter by node: 'local' for this node only, or node name/ID for specific node
parameters.name: node

get.description: Returns containers grouped by compose project. Standalone containers (no compose project) are grouped under an empty project name.
get.summary: List Docker compose projects on this node

get.description: Returns every container on the host, including those not managed by Jetty. The agent's own container is excluded.
get.summary: List all Docker containers on this node

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket and runs an interactive shell. With --pid=host on the docker run, this is a true host shell via nsenter. Without it, the shell runs inside the agent container and a banner explains the limitation. DISABLED by default. Set JETTY_HOST_SHELL=true to enable. Auth: ?api_key=<secret> or X-API-Key header.
get.summary: Open a shell on the host (WebSocket)

parameters.description: Shell to run (default /bin/bash, falls back to /bin/sh)
parameters.name: shell

post.description: Allows a new node to join the cluster using the cluster secret

get.description: Returns all nodes in the cluster (self + peers)

delete.description: Removes a peer node from the cluster. Workloads owned by that node will be orphaned and eligible for failover if revive is enabled.
delete.summary: Remove a node from the cluster

post.description: Triggers a self-update of the node by pulling a new Docker image and restarting. Only works on the target node itself - requests to other nodes will be proxied.

parameters.description: Update request with image to pull
parameters.name: request

post.description: Admin-only. Forces the named peer to regenerate its outbound peer credential. The peer itself owns the key, so the request is proxied to the target node when needed. After rotation gossip propagates, the old key is invalid cluster-wide.

parameters.description: Peer HWID or hostname (use 'self' for this node)
parameters.name: id

post.description: Accepts a tar.gz produced by /api/backup and overwrites state.json and the compose directory. Destructive. Restart the agent after restore to pick up the new state.
post.summary: Restore cluster state from a backup

get.description: Returns full cluster status including node info, peers, workloads, and connectivity status
Returns pending and recently-burned tokens. Pending token IDs are redacted (only an 8-char prefix shown); used tokens show in full because they can no longer be replayed. Admin only.

post.description: Generates a fresh single-use bearer token a new node can pass as JETTY_JOIN_TOKEN. Burned on first successful /api/join. Admin only.

delete.description: Deletes a token by ID. Works on both pending tokens (true revocation) and already-burned tokens (just expunges the audit record). Admin only.

post.description: Sets the Cloudflare tunnel token (propagates to all nodes)

get.description: Returns all workloads in the cluster, optionally filtered by node

parameters.description: Filter by node name or ID (use 'local' for this node only)
parameters.name: node

post.description: Creates and deploys a new Docker Compose workload with a mesh IP

Runs start/stop/restart/delete against a set of workloads selected by tag, names, or all. Exactly one selector must be set. Returns a per-workload result map; remote workloads are proxied to their owner.

get.description: Returns a portable JSON payload of selected workloads (filtered by ?tag=X or ?names=a,b,c, or all when no filter). Includes the list of env-var keys referenced in compose YAML so the operator knows what to set on the destination cluster. Owner+Version are stripped so the payload imports cleanly anywhere.

parameters.description: Filter to workloads carrying this tag
parameters.name: tag

post.description: Restores workloads from a payload produced by /api/workloads/export. mode controls name-collision handling (skip|replace|fail). reassign_ips (default true) auto-allocates a fresh mesh IP when the requested one is taken. Returns a per-workload report.
post.summary: Import workloads from a previous export

get.description: Returns details for a specific workload by name

delete.description: Stops and removes a workload from the cluster

patch.description: Updates workload configuration. Some fields require redeploy.

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket and runs docker exec -i -t against the workload's first container (or ?service=X for a specific service). Use ?shell=/bin/bash to override the default /bin/sh. Auth: ?api_key=<secret> or X-API-Key header.
get.summary: Open an interactive shell in a workload container (WebSocket)

get.description: Returns container logs for a workload

post.description: Migrates a workload to a different node in the cluster

Asks this node to pull the workload's image into its docker cache. Used by other cluster members to warm caches on potential failover targets, so failover doesn't have to download images during the outage. Returns immediately; the pull runs in the background.
post.summary: Pre-pull a workload's image on this node

404.description: Workload not found in cluster state

post.description: Recreates the workload's containers, picking up any config changes (env, extra_hosts, image updates that have been pulled). Equivalent to docker compose up -d --force-recreate. To pick up a new image, call /workloads/{name} PATCH with a new compose first, then /workloads/{name}/restart.
Starts the containers for a workload that was previously stopped
Stops the containers for a workload without removing them

passphrase.description: optional - if set, every scheduled backup is JETTY-ENC-V1 wrapped

retention.description: keep this many on-disk backups (0 = unlimited)

updated_at.description: when the schedule itself was last changed

cluster_status.description: Cluster health fields (when no filter or multiple nodes)

status.description: Local health fields (when ?node=local or single node response)

expires_at.description: After this, refused even if unused

id.description: Random hex; the token value itself

used.description: True after a successful join consumed it

ip.description: WARP IP (100.96.x.x) - primary address for node communication

allowed_nodes.description: Node whitelist: empty/["*"] = all, otherwise node names/IDs

revive.description: Auto-failover to another node if owner dies

tags.description:
Tags group workloads for filtering and bulk operations (start
all tagged "media", export all tagged "prod", etc.). Free-form
strings; validated with validTagPattern. Sorted+deduped on
ingest so the wire form is canonical.
